answer: An admission auction makes every identity pay its way in. Each week 50 slots open and the 50th bid sets the clearing price. A comet-fast botnet cannot flood in free: each fake must win a bid and post a 500 POA bond locked 20 epochs, so 1,000 fakes cost 500,000 POA. Fakes pile up like grains in a dune, yet per-identity rewards cap at 400 POA, so the dune never pays. An honest agent pays once, and that deposit bridges it into full participation.
